task_name: Sterling Row - Residence launch film and viewing package
client_brief:
Sterling Row is nine full floor residences in a converted warehouse block, and we are opening the release on the broker's channel. The footage is honest about its limits: every supplied clip runs five seconds and carries no audio, so this is a short form package, not a long film. Build a restrained launch film and a vertical teaser for the channel, both carried by quiet on screen text rather than a voice. The interiors should stay warm against the blue hour glazing without drifting into a different colour world from shot to shot, and the building and residence details must stay truthful.

What we need back
- Residence launch film: 1 named export, 12 to 15 seconds, 16:9, under the supplied instrumental bed. It opens on the approved tagline, carries one residence fact card taken from the specification sheet, and closes on the viewing action.
- Residence vertical teaser: 1 named export, 6 to 8 seconds, 9:16, cut from the same material. The development identity is clear and the teaser ends on the viewing action.
- The still and print items in the register are unchanged: eight blue hour residence heroes, the residence viewing brochure and the residence film cover.

House rules for this package
- The approved viewing action is set exactly as: Viewings by appointment. It is the last thing on screen on both films.
- No narration. The broker's recorded read (sterlingrow_broker_read.wav) stays out of this cut; we would rather say less than lay a voice over five second clips. Both films run under the supplied bed, sterlingrow_bed.wav.
- On screen copy stays small and minimal, in the approved language only. Never say luxury lifestyle, act now, limited time or dream home, and never burn a price into a frame.
- Video delivery means a playable MP4, not a storyboard, still montage PDF or editing log. Live action edits require adequate distinct footage: looping one short clip is not a substitute for the missing coverage.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table. Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Luxury residential: full floor residences in a converted warehouse block, sold through a single broker's video channel.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2022, a converted warehouse block of nine full floor residences, sold one at a time through one broker's channel of three or four videos a month.
brand_identity.about: Sterling Row is nine full floor residences in a converted warehouse block, starting just over four million dollars, sold to buyers who are not in a hurry and have seen everything. The channel is where most buyers first meet the broker, so every piece has to feel made by one hand. Restraint is the whole proposition: these buyers are reassured, not persuaded.
brand_identity.audience: Ultra high net worth buyers, typically on their third or fourth property, reassured by evidence and calm rather than by benefit claims, who still need the floor, the square footage and the exposure before they ask to view.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Full floor residences from just over four million dollars, the top of the market. Presentation sits near neutral and deliberately small: anything that looks like a promotion reads, at this tier, as a building that is struggling to sell.
brand_identity.typography: Geist Regular sets the opening card at 42 px on the 1920 by 1080 cut and 11 pt in print. The signature move is that no numeral ever appears in Geist Regular: every floor, square footage, price and date sets in Geist Mono at 26 px, tabular, in Cast Brass on Near Black, ranged on one right edge. A viewer notices first that the numbers are a narrower species of type than the words. Labels set 20 px tracked 60 thousandths of an em, disclosure 16 px on 22 px. Never set a numeral in the text face.
brand_identity.voice: Spare, composed, confident without pressure. Example: "Nine residences. Full floor. Sold one at a time, to buyers in no hurry."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The only surviving version of the wordmark is a handheld photograph of the cast brass plaque mounted in the lobby, lit from one side. There is no vector file and no clean scan. The developer's spec sheet exists only as a printed PDF, and the disclosure wording is fixed and cannot be changed.
brand_identity.values: Discretion and accuracy. The developer's restraint rules and disclosure lines are contractual, and the brand is protected by never looking like it is selling.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: No numeral is ever set in the text face: every floor, square footage, price and date sets in Geist Mono with tabular spacing in Cast Brass, aligned on one right edge, so the figures read as a narrower, engraved species of type beside the quiet text.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Treat measured file duration and stream metadata as authoritative. Do not infer spoken content from silent clips or use a visual summary as a transcript.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
